nodes.label: D-004 Nothing is cited unless it is in the corpus
nodes.norm_label: d-004 nothing is cited unless it is in the corpus
nodes.rationale: A language model citing rules from memory invents numbering with total confidence; a misquoted rule is a badly founded decision.

nodes.label: D-007 Three separate material stores: rules, examples, phrases
nodes.norm_label: d-007 three separate material stores: rules, examples, phrases
nodes.rationale: They have different levels of trust; a user phrase must never be presented as a rule, an example must never be cited as authority.

nodes.label: D-008 The rules corpus is layered, with precedence
nodes.norm_label: d-008 the rules corpus is layered, with precedence
nodes.rationale: Sailing instructions and amendments modify the RRS; citing the RRS while ignoring an event amendment yields a citation that is correct and a decision that is wrong.

nodes.label: R-01 Nothing is cited unless it is in the corpus
nodes.norm_label: r-01 nothing is cited unless it is in the corpus
nodes.rationale: Failure if broken: a confidently invented rule number in a signed decision.

nodes.label: R-03 Event material overrides permanent material
nodes.norm_label: r-03 event material overrides permanent material
nodes.rationale: Failure if broken: a citation that is correct and a decision that is wrong.

nodes.label: R-04 The three stores never mix
nodes.norm_label: r-04 the three stores never mix
nodes.rationale: Failure if broken: the user's own past wording acquires the appearance of legal force.

nodes.label: D-001 v1 covers protests only
nodes.rationale: Redress hearings have a different form and flow; building both at once doubles surface before either is proven.

nodes.label: D-002 Product entirely in English
nodes.rationale: Racing rules' defined terms are native to English and carry exact technical meaning that does not survive translation.

nodes.label: D-003 Single user, local first, no accounts in v1
nodes.norm_label: d-003 single user, local first, no accounts in v1
nodes.rationale: The owner is the only user; accounts/roles/permissions are the classic sink for personal projects that will 'one day' be multi-user.

nodes.label: D-005 No .docx export in v1, copy-paste per box
nodes.norm_label: d-005 no .docx export in v1, copy-paste per box
nodes.rationale: Export was the least valuable and most tedious block of work and carried a library licensing question that no longer needs answering.

nodes.label: D-014 Rules Applicable stored as a separate table
nodes.norm_label: d-014 rules applicable stored as a separate table
nodes.rationale: Rules Applicable is a hybrid (free text now, validated against corpus later); a table survives that transition without migration.

nodes.label: D-017 Copy-per-box covers all 8 form sections
nodes.norm_label: d-017 copy-per-box covers all 8 form sections
nodes.rationale: 'Writing assistance' is narrower than 'copy to clipboard'; the whole document gets pasted into the official decision one piece at a time.

nodes.label: R-21 The application does not assume the user is the owner
nodes.norm_label: r-21 the application does not assume the user is the owner
nodes.rationale: Whether authentication is required is configuration, not a rewrite.

nodes.label: D-009 Everything is stored as Markdown
nodes.norm_label: d-009 everything is stored as markdown
nodes.rationale: One format for the AI to read, one format for the index, no per-format branching in code.

nodes.label: D-010 No OCR
nodes.rationale: OCR is a heavy dependency inside the container; the user's workflow already handles it externally.

nodes.label: R-09 Everything is stored as Markdown
nodes.norm_label: r-09 everything is stored as markdown
nodes.rationale: PDF, Excel, Word and Markdown all enter; .md is the only stored format.

nodes.label: R-10 The original is always kept
nodes.norm_label: r-10 the original is always kept
nodes.rationale: Next to its .md, for as long as the .md exists; rejecting an import deletes both, leaving no orphans.

nodes.label: R-11 The .md is never hand-edited
nodes.rationale: It is always the product of conversion; fix the source and re-upload, or delete to regenerate.

nodes.label: R-12 Warn on an empty conversion
nodes.norm_label: r-12 warn on an empty conversion
nodes.rationale: Failure if broken: a rulebook that is 'loaded' and empty, discovered exactly when it is needed.

nodes.label: R-13 All data lives under data/
nodes.norm_label: r-13 all data lives under data/
nodes.rationale: Failure if broken: containerisation becomes a puzzle and backup becomes unreliable.

nodes.label: R-19 The server listens on 0.0.0.0
nodes.rationale: Inside a container, localhost is unreachable from outside; the most common first-time containerisation error.

nodes.label: R-20 Timezone comes from configuration, never the host
nodes.norm_label: r-20 timezone comes from configuration, never the host
nodes.rationale: Containers default to UTC, but decisions record event time.

nodes.label: D-006 Editor: CodeMirror 6, TipTap rejected
nodes.rationale: TipTap's Content AI requires a paid subscription and reserves custom LLM backends for the business plan; this project uses Claude, self-hosted. CodeMirror covers both suggestion mechanisms in one engine at no cost.

nodes.label: R-24 Prefer the deterministic path
nodes.rationale: If exact matching against the phrase library can produce a suggestion, do not call a model for it.

nodes.label: R-25 Debounce every model call, cancel superseded ones
nodes.norm_label: r-25 debounce every model call, cancel superseded ones
nodes.rationale: Failure if broken: a request per keypress, which here means money per keypress.

nodes.label: R-02 Every rule statement shows its source
nodes.norm_label: r-02 every rule statement shows its source
nodes.rationale: Failure if broken: the user cannot check, so they trust; trust is exactly what must not be required.

nodes.label: R-05 When the system is unsure, it says so
nodes.norm_label: r-05 when the system is unsure, it says so
nodes.rationale: No plausible filler; an empty suggestion is better than a confident wrong one.

nodes.label: R-06 The tool never decides a case
nodes.norm_label: r-06 the tool never decides a case
nodes.rationale: Facts Found, Conclusion and Decision are authored by the human.

nodes.label: R-07 Nothing is inserted without the user's action
nodes.norm_label: r-07 nothing is inserted without the user's action
nodes.rationale: No auto-accept, no silent replacement of text the user wrote.

nodes.label: R-08 Conversion is reviewed before it counts
nodes.norm_label: r-08 conversion is reviewed before it counts
nodes.rationale: Imported material is not usable until the user has seen the Markdown and accepted it.

nodes.label: R-14 Permanent and event material stay in separate directories
nodes.norm_label: r-14 permanent and event material stay in separate directories
nodes.rationale: Event material is replaced at every regatta; see R-03.

nodes.label: R-15 Relative paths only
nodes.rationale: The same project must run unchanged on the Ubuntu server.

nodes.label: R-17 The .env file is never committed
nodes.norm_label: r-17 the .env file is never committed
nodes.rationale: Failure if broken: the API key is in the Git history forever, even after deletion from the working tree.

nodes.label: R-18 The API key never reaches the browser
nodes.community_name: Rule R18 API Key Server Only
nodes.norm_label: r-18 the api key never reaches the browser
nodes.rationale: This is the entire reason the backend exists; all model calls go through the API.

nodes.label: R-23 Everything that is not AI works offline
nodes.norm_label: r-23 everything that is not ai works offline
nodes.rationale: Connections fail at events; the tool must not.

nodes.label: R-26 Use prompt caching for corpus and system prompt
nodes.norm_label: r-26 use prompt caching for corpus and system prompt
nodes.rationale: This is the single largest saving in this usage pattern.

nodes.label: R-27 The product is in English
nodes.norm_label: r-27 the product is in english

nodes.label: R-28 Use the defined terms
nodes.rationale: A paraphrase in Facts Found is an error, not a stylistic choice.

nodes.label: R-29 The form's labels are authoritative, with one correction
nodes.norm_label: r-29 the form's labels are authoritative, with one correction
nodes.rationale: Source template reads 'Fact Founds'; the correct term is Facts Found.

nodes.label: R-30 No real case content in examples shipped with the project
nodes.community_name: Rule R30 No Real Case Content
nodes.norm_label: r-30 no real case content in examples shipped with the project
nodes.rationale: Base examples are published material or anonymised; personal data of competitors does not go into a repository.

nodes.label: R-31 A user's own material stays their own
nodes.community_name: Rule R31 Own Material Stays Own
nodes.norm_label: r-31 a user's own material stays their own
nodes.rationale: examples/own and phrases/ are per-user; sharing the tool does not mean sharing case files.

nodes.label: R-32 Every significant decision goes in DECISIONS.md
nodes.norm_label: r-32 every significant decision goes in decisions.md
nodes.rationale: Append only; supersede rather than edit.

nodes.label: R-33 Each phase ends with something usable
nodes.norm_label: r-33 each phase ends with something usable
nodes.rationale: No phase leaves the tool in a state where it cannot be taken to a regatta.

nodes.label: R-34 Offline first, uncertain last
nodes.rationale: This is why inline AI completion is the last feature, not the first.

nodes.label: R-35 Verify product facts against current documentation
nodes.norm_label: r-35 verify product facts against current documentation
nodes.rationale: Model names, pricing, library licences and API behaviour change; check at implementation time.

nodes.label: Scribe Helper Architecture (TS, React/Vite, CodeMirror 6, Fastify, SQLite, Docker)
nodes.norm_label: scribe helper architecture (ts, react/vite, codemirror 6, fastify, sqlite, docker)

nodes.label: D-011 SQLite, not Postgres; FTS5, not a vector database
nodes.norm_label: d-011 sqlite, not postgres; fts5, not a vector database
nodes.rationale: One user, one writer; SQLite needs no container/administration. Parsing RRS by rule number and keyword search is more precise and cheaper than embeddings at this corpus size.

nodes.label: D-012 Built to be containerised from day one
nodes.norm_label: d-012 built to be containerised from day one
nodes.rationale: Rules like env-var config, data under one directory, 0.0.0.0 binding and configurable TZ are free now and painful later.

nodes.label: D-013 File sync exclusions (.stignore)
nodes.rationale: Real-time sync over thousands of small files corrupts repos, and syncing a live SQLite file mid-write corrupts the database.

nodes.label: D-015 Table named protest_case, not case
nodes.norm_label: d-015 table named protest_case, not case
nodes.rationale: CASE is a reserved SQL keyword; using it as a table name forces quoting everywhere and invites mistakes.

nodes.label: D-016 SQLite access via node:sqlite, not better-sqlite3
nodes.norm_label: d-016 sqlite access via node:sqlite, not better-sqlite3
nodes.rationale: better-sqlite3 failed to compile (no Visual Studio C++ toolchain); node:sqlite ships with Node itself and needs no native compilation.

nodes.label: R-16 All configuration through environment variables
nodes.norm_label: r-16 all configuration through environment variables
nodes.rationale: Port, API key, paths, timezone; nothing hardcoded.

nodes.label: R-22 Keep the data layer separable
nodes.norm_label: r-22 keep the data layer separable
nodes.rationale: Moving to Postgres should be a day's work, not a rewrite.
